title: Levensduur en sloop van personenauto's 1989
descriptions: Influence of technical factors and economic behaviour of owners on life time of cars. R had a car with a particular licence-plate number in time-period before 1988 / what happened to the car / main reason that car was sold / reason for the defect / nr. of kilometres driven in that car / licence-number on own name or business name / reason that the car had been bought. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ occupation/employment
